leadText:
Blossom (Japanese: ツボミ Tsubomi) is a character who appeared in Blossom's Dream, the third episode of the POKÉTOON animated shorts.
 
She is the daughter of two former s. When she was younger, Blossom watched videos of her father competing in the Galar League in his youth, which inspired her to start a journey of her own and become a Champion. Her mother was not very supportive of this, however. Even so, Blossom bought a large amount of s and Potions at the local Poké Mart and ventured into the wild to try and capture a Pokémon. Unfortunately, she proved unsuccessful in capturing several Pokémon.

Eventually, Blossom came across a and saved him from an . Just as she started to bond with Nidoran♂, his parents, a and a , showed up. The parents assumed Blossom meant harm to Nidoran♂ and chased her back to her hometown. The Nidoking and Nidoqueen were stopped from entering the town by a couple of local Trainers using their Pokémon. Meanwhile, Blossom rushed home to get her father's , Char-ly, to help out. Riding and commanding Char-ly, she was able to put a stop to the fight between Nidoran♂'s parents and the Trainers. Nidoran♂ had become attached to Blossom and chose to stay with her and leave his parents.

Blossom's parents were left impressed with her handling of Char-ly and her ability to stop a conflict. They allowed her to leave on a journey with Nidoran♂ and watched as she left town. At some point in their journey, Nidoran♂ evolved into . In a forest, Blossom encountered a and sent out Nidorino to battle it, having become a capable Trainer of her own.
